h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dhanbad

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dhanbad

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Dhanbad

c: Coal dust settles on everything in Dhanbad, and an outdoor gym in a colliery colony or a city park has to cope with it every day. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to townships, housing societies, schools and municipal parks across Dhanbad. We build each machine at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,480 km away, and send it to you by road.

Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India fixes the machines on site, either grouted into the ground or on a self-standing base. Many enquiries from the Jharia and Dhanbad belt come from staff colonies where walkers already use the roads at dawn. Others come from college campuses that want a free fitness corner for students and staff. Send us the size of the plot and a few photos. We reply with a layout that marks the clear space each machine needs, so your committee can see the plan before approving a quote.

richText.heading: Keeping outdoor gym equipment working in a dusty mining town

c: Fine dust gets into pivots and makes moving parts stiff. The frames are galvanised pipe, so they resist rust, but the bearings need a wipe and a check every few weeks in a coal town. Machines with fewer moving joints are easier to look after. A
each have one simple swing or push action.

items.q: Will coal dust damage outdoor gym machines in Dhanbad?
items.a: Dust does not harm the galvanised frames, but it can stiffen bearings over time. Wipe the moving parts regularly, wash the station after dry spells and follow the maintenance steps we hand over after installation.

items.q: What warranty comes with your outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years. Bearings, springs and spare parts carry 1 year. The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the machines are installed and maintained as per our instructions.

items.q: Can a colliery colony start with only a few machines?
items.a: Yes. Each Fun Fitness station has its own base. You can begin with two or three machines along a walking path and add more in a later budget year without changing the first layout.
